name: Grip Event Organiser
description: Grip Event Organiser MCP connects Claude directly to your live event platform data so you can take action quickly on your event configuration.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grip Event Organiser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grip Event Organiser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.grip.events/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grip Event Organiser MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grip Event Organiser provides these MCP tools: get_container, list_applications, and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grip Event Organiser?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grip Event Organiser in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Grip Event Organiser MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grip Event Organiser requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grip Event Organiser is developed by Grip (Intros.at Ltd). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
